risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (299.84) with recent CPI event dominates; normal yield curve and falling DXY provide limited offset; 63-day earnings window presents moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (EMA 50/200 and SMA 50/200 bullish, price above 200-MA) with supertrend bullish and fear-zone VIX present contrarian opportunity for patient accumulation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Short-term momentum is severely conflicted (RSI9 oversold but not rising, bearish stoch cross, negative CMF, price below EMA9/21/SMA21) combined with crisis VIX regime, zero fundamental catalysts, and 63-day earnings risk make this a poor swing entry without near-term confirmation.
